rationale: Supersede the stale ADD_PENDING_TRANSACTION recommendation because primary subsequent evidence shows that Antin's majority investment closed by July 2024. Preserve GTL Leasing as one active company and retain its existing NextGen Fund I ownership period, while recording the disclosed majority stake, correcting the description to completed ownership, adding the official website, removing an unsupported headquarters value, refreshing verification, and attaching direct evidence to its two existing milestones.

companyFieldUpdates.description: GTL Leasing is a North American operating lessor of high-pressure gaseous and cryogenic trailers, storage tanks, cylinders and related equipment used to transport and store hydrogen, compressed natural gas and other industrial gases. The company serves utilities, transportation, telecommunications, energy and industrial customers and provides integrated maintenance and re-testing services from facilities in Catoosa, Oklahoma and Livermore, California. Antin Infrastructure Partners completed a majority investment through NextGen Fund I in July 2024. The exact ownership percentage and transaction value were not publicly disclosed.
